expected_effects: Identification of candidate objects for manipulation.
Red bowl is secured in gripper.
Bowl is positioned above the white plate.

preconditions: Bowl is aligned with plate center.

expected_effects: Second attempt to secure the bowl.
preconditions: Previous grasp failed or object slipped.

goal_interpretation: Identify the specific red bowl among the two visible candidates, grasp it securely, transport it to the white plate, align it centrally on the plate surface, and release it.

nodes.description: Initial scene with two red bowls and one white plate on the table.
observable_conditions: Two red bowls are present on the left side.
One white plate is present on the right side.
unknown_conditions: Which red bowl is the intended target for manipulation.
Grasp stability of the red bowls.
Exact center coordinates of the white plate.

nodes.description: Decision point to select the correct red bowl based on task context or default heuristic.
observable_conditions: Spatial relationship between bowls and plate.
unknown_conditions: User preference if not specified by position.

nodes.description: Robot approaches and attempts to grasp the selected red bowl.
observable_conditions: Gripper closure around the bowl rim or body.
unknown_conditions: Friction coefficient of the bowl material.
Weight of the bowl affecting grip force.

nodes.description: Move the held bowl over the white plate and align to the estimated center.
observable_conditions: Bowl position relative to plate boundaries.
unknown_conditions: Potential collision with plate rim during approach.

nodes.description: Release the bowl onto the plate and verify it remains centered and stable.
observable_conditions: Visual symmetry of bowl relative to plate edge.

objects.description: Red cylindrical bowl located at the front-left of the table.
Red cylindrical bowl located behind red_bowl_1.
White circular plate located on the right side of the table.

physical_checks: Verify the selected red bowl is not too heavy for the gripper payload limit.
Check if the white plate surface is stable and will not slide during placement.
Confirm the red bowl's geometry allows for a stable top-down or side grasp.
Ensure the placement height accounts for the plate's thickness to avoid dropping from too high.
